1.1: Nwoma yi fa adiyisɛm a Onyankopɔn de maa Yesu Kristo sɛ ɔnkyerɛ nʼasomfoɔ deɛ ɛrebɛba no ho. Kristo somaa ne ɔbɔfoɔ kɔɔ nʼakoa Yohane nkyɛn kɔdaa asɛm yi adi kyerɛɛ no,
1.2: sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a Yohane bɛka biribiara a ɔhunuiɛ. Yei ne nʼadansedie ne asɛm a ɛfiri Onyankopɔn nkyɛn ne nokorɛ a Yesu Kristo daa no adi no.
1.3: Nhyira nka obiara a ɔbɛkan saa nwoma yi, na nhyira nka wɔn nso a wɔtie adiyisɛm no na wɔdi so sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ wɔ saa nwoma yi mu no. Ɛberɛ no abɛn.
1.4: Yohane, Nkyea a ɔkyea asafo ahodoɔ nson a ɛwɔ Asia no nie: Adom ne asomdwoeɛ a ɛfiri deɛ ɔwɔ hɔ, na ɔtenaa hɔ, na ɔreba no ne ahonhom nson a wɔwɔ nʼahennwa anim,
1.5: ne Yesu Kristo a ɔyɛ ɔdanseni nokwafoɔ ne awufoɔ mu abakan ne asase so ahene sodifoɔ no nkyɛn nka mo. Ɔdɔ yɛn, na ɔnam ne wuo no so agye yɛn afiri yɛn bɔne mu.
1.6: Wayɛ yɛn ahemman ne asɔfoɔ sɛ yɛnsom ne Onyankopɔn ne nʼAgya. Ɔno na wɔmfa animuonyam ne tumi mma no daa daa! Amen.
1.7: Ɔnam omununkum mu reba. Wɔn a wɔwɔɔ no pea no ne obiara bɛhunu no. Asase so nnipa nyinaa bɛsu no.
1.8: Awurade Onyankopɔn Otumfoɔ no se, “Mene Alfa ne Omega a ɔwɔ hɔ seesei na ɔwɔ hɔ dada na ɔrebɛba no.”
1.9: Mene Yohane, a me ne mo nyinaa yɛ akyidifoɔ. Yɛhunu amane ɛfiri sɛ Yesu ne yɛn ɔhene, na ɔma yɛn ahoɔden wɔ ahohia mu. Esiane sɛ mekaa Onyankopɔn asɛm kaa nokorɛ a Yesu daa no adi enti, wɔtwaa me asuo de me kɔɔ Supɔ Patmo so.
1.10: Awurade da no, Honhom no faa me na metee nne denden bi a ɛte sɛ totorobɛnto a ɛrebɔ wɔ mʼakyi.
1.11: Ɛkaa sɛ, “Twerɛ biribiara a wohunu, na fa nwoma no kɔma saa asafo ahodoɔ nson a ɛwɔ Efeso ne Smirna ne Pergamo ne Tiatira ne Sardi ne Filadelfia ne Laodikea no.”
1.12: Medanee mʼani pɛɛ sɛ mehunu deɛ ɔrekasa kyerɛ me no. Ɛhɔ na mehunuu sikakɔkɔɔ nkaneadua nson.
1.13: Na nkaneadua no mfimfini na onipa bi a ɔte sɛ Onipa Ba a ɔhyɛ atadeɛ yuu a ɛsi ne nan ase a sika abɔsoɔ kyekyere ne koko no gyina.
1.14: Na ne tirinwi yɛ fitaa te sɛ asaawafuturo anaasɛ sukyerɛmma, na nʼani dɛre sɛ ogya.
1.15: Ne nan ase hyerɛnee sɛ ayowaa a wɔanane wɔ fononoo mu na afei wɔatwi ho na ne nne woro so te sɛ nsuworosoɔ a ano yɛ den.
1.16: Na ɔkura nsoromma nson wɔ ne nsa nifa mu na sekan anofanu a ɛyɛ nnam firi nʼanom baeɛ. Na nʼanim hyerɛn te sɛ owigyinaeɛ awia.
1.17: Mehunuu no no, mekɔhwee ne nan ase te sɛ owufoɔ. Ɔde ne nsa nifa too me so kaa sɛ, “Nsuro! Mene Ɔkannifoɔ ne Okyikafoɔ.
1.18: Mene ɔteasefoɔ no! Mewuiɛ, nanso seesei mete ase daa daa. Mekura owuo ne asaman safoa.
1.19: “Enti afei twerɛ nneɛma a wohunu; deɛ wohunu no seesei ne deɛ ɛbɛba akyire no, twerɛ.
1.20: Nsoromma nson a wohunu wɔ me nsa nifa mu ne sika nkaneadua no nkyerɛaseɛ a ɛyɛ ahintasɛm no ni; Nsoromma nson no yɛ asafo nson no abɔfoɔ, ɛnna nkaneadua nson no nso yɛ asafo nson no.”

2.1: “Twerɛ krataa yi kɔma ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtua Efeso asafo no ano, na ka kyerɛ no sɛ: Yei ne nsɛm a ɛfiri obi a ɔkura nsoromma nson wɔ ne nsa nifa mu a ɔnante wɔ sika nkaneadua nson no ntam no.
2.2: Menim deɛ woayɛ. Menim nsi a wode ayɛ adwuma ne boasetɔ a wowɔ. Menim sɛ wonnye nnebɔneyɛfoɔ, na afei woasɔ wɔn a wɔka sɛ wɔyɛ asomafoɔ nanso wɔnnyɛ bi no ahwɛ, na woahunu sɛ wɔyɛ atorofoɔ.
2.3: Wowɔ boasetɔ, na me enti, woahunu amane bebree, nanso wompaa aba.
2.4: Nanso, deɛ mewɔ tia wo ne sɛ, wonnɔ me, sɛdeɛ kan no na wodɔ me no.
2.5: Hunu ba a woaba fam no. Te wo ho firi bɔne ho na yɛ sɛdeɛ kane no na woyɛ no. Sɛ woantwe wo ho amfiri wo bɔne ho a, mɛba wo nkyɛn na mabɛyi wo kaneadua no afiri ne siberɛ.
2.6: Nanso, deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ wo ho ne sɛ, wokyiri deɛ Nikolaifoɔ no yɛ no, na saa ara na me nso mekyiri.
2.7: Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no ka kyerɛ asafo ahodoɔ no bi. Wɔn a wɔadi nkonim no, mɛma wɔn tumi na wɔadi nkwadua a ɛwɔ Onyankopɔn paradise hɔ.
2.8: “Twerɛ krataa yi kɔma ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtua Smirna asafo no ano sɛ: Saa asɛm yi firi Ahyɛaseɛ ne Awieeɛ no nkyɛn. Deɛ ɔwuiɛ na ɔnyaneeɛ no.
2.9: Menim amane a wohunu maa Awurade na menim wʼahiasɛm nyinaa nso, nanso wowɔ agyapadeɛ wɔ ɔsoro. Menim nsɛm a wɔn a wɔse wɔyɛ Yudafoɔ nanso wɔnyɛ Yudafoɔ no ka tia wo. Wɔyɛ ɔbonsam apamfoɔ.
2.10: Nsuro ɔhaw a ɛrebɛto wo no. Tie! Wɔde mo mu bi bɛto afiase na ɔbonsam nam so asɔ mo ahwɛ. Na mo haw bɛdi dadu. Sɛ owuo mu mpo a, gye me di na mɛma wo nkwa abotire.
2.11: Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no ka kyerɛ asafo no. Wɔn a wɔdi nkonim no renwu owuprenu.
2.12: “Twerɛ krataa yi kɔma ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔwɔ Pergamo asafo mu sɛ: Saa krataa yi firi deɛ ɔwɔ akofena anofanu a ɛyɛ nnam no nkyɛn.
2.13: Menim sɛ faako a wote no, ɛhɔ na ɔbonsam ahennwa si. Wodi me nokorɛ; na ɛberɛ a wɔkumm Antipa a ɔyɛ ɔdanseni nokwafoɔ wɔ faako a ɔbonsam te no mpo, woampa me.
2.14: Nanso, nneɛma kakra a mewɔ tia wo ne sɛ, nnipa bi a wɔdi Bileam nkyerɛkyerɛakyi no ka wo ho wɔ hɔ. Saa Bileam no na ɔkyerɛɛ Balak maa ɔmaa Israelfoɔ dii abosom so nnuane, kyerɛɛ wɔn adwamammɔ, nam so ma wɔyɛɛ bɔne no.
2.15: Saa ara nso na wowɔ nnipa bi ka wo ho a wɔdi Nikolaifoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ akyi.
2.16: Twe wo ho firi wo bɔne ho. Anyɛ saa a, ɛrenkyɛre biara mɛba wo nkyɛn, na mede sekan a ɛfiri mʼanom no abɛko atia saa nnipa no.
2.17: Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no ka kyerɛ asafo ahodoɔ no. Mo a moadi nkonim no, mɛma mo mana a ahinta no bi. Afei, mɛma wɔn mu biara ɛboɔ fitaa a wɔatwerɛ din foforɔ wɔ so a obiara nnim, gye onipa a wɔde bɛma no no.
2.18: “Twerɛ krataa kɔma ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔwɔ Tiatira asafo mu sɛ: Yei ne asɛm a ɛfiri Onyankopɔn Ba no a nʼani dɛre sɛ ogyaframa a ne nan ase hyerɛn sɛ ayowaa no nkyɛn.
2.19: Menim deɛ woyɛ. Menim wo dɔ, wo gyidie, wo som ne boasetɔ a wowɔ. Menim sɛ woreyɛ adwuma sene kane no.
2.20: Nanso deɛ mewɔ tia wo ne sɛ, wogyee ɔbaa bi a ne din de Isabel, a ɔfrɛ ne ho, Onyankopɔn odiyifoɔ no too mu. Saa ɔbaa yi kyerɛkyerɛ, na ɔdi mʼasomafoɔ anim ma wɔbɔ adwaman di abosom aduane.
2.21: Mama no ɛberɛ sɛ ɔnnu ne ho mfiri ne bɔne mu, nanso ɔmpɛ sɛ ɔsakyera firi nʼadwamammɔ mu.
2.22: Ɛno enti, sɛ wɔansesa amfiri amumuyɛ a wɔne no yɛeɛ no mu a, mɛto no ahwe mpa so na ɔno ne wɔn a wɔsɛe awadeɛ no ahunu amane a ano yɛ den yie.
2.23: Afei, mɛkum nʼakyidifoɔ no, na asafo no nyinaa bɛhunu sɛ mene obi a mehunu nnipa adwene mu ne wɔn akɔnnɔ. Deɛ mo mu biara yɛeɛ no, mɛtua no so ka pɛpɛɛpɛ.
2.24: Nanso, momu bi a mowɔ Tiatira no nni saa nkyerɛkyerɛ bɔne no akyi. Monsuaa deɛ afoforɔ frɛ no ‘Ɔbonsam asumansɛm’ no. Meka mekyerɛ mo sɛ, meremfa adesoa foforɔ biara nto mo so.
2.25: Na monsɔ deɛ mowɔ no mu denden kɔsi sɛ mɛba.
2.26: Wɔn a wɔdi nkonim na wɔkɔ so yɛ deɛ mepɛ kɔsi awieeɛ no, mede tumi korɔ no ara a menya firii
2.27: mʼAgya hɔ no bɛma wɔn. Mɛma wɔn aman so tumi na wɔde dadeɛ poma adi wɔn so na wɔabobɔ wɔn sɛ nkukuo.
2.28: Afei, mede anɔpa nsoromma bɛma wɔn.
2.29: Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no ka kyerɛ asafo no.

3.1: “Twerɛ krataa yi kɔma ɔbɔfoɔ ɔwɔ asafo a ɛwɔ Sardi no sɛ: Yei ne asɛm a ɛfiri deɛ ɔwɔ Onyankopɔn ahonhom nson ne nsoromma nson no nkyɛn. Menim deɛ woreyɛ. Menim sɛ woagye din sɛ wote ase, nanso woawu.
3.2: Enti nyane, na kanyane deɛ aka wo nkyɛn no na anwu koraa. Ɛfiri sɛ, mahunu sɛ deɛ woayɛ no nya nnii mu wɔ Onyankopɔn anim.
3.3: Kae deɛ wɔkyerɛɛ wo no ne sɛdeɛ woteeɛ no. Di so na twe wo ho firi wo bɔne ho. Sɛ woankanyane wo ho a, mɛba wo so sɛ ɔkorɔmfoɔ, na worenhunu ɛberɛ ko a mɛba.
3.4: Nanso, mo mu kakra bi a wɔwɔ Sardi no mfaa ewiase nkekaeɛ nkekaa wɔn ntadeɛ mu. Wɔne me bɛnante a wɔhyɛ ntadeɛ fitaa, ɛfiri sɛ, ɛsɛ wɔn sɛ wɔyɛ saa.
3.5: Deɛ ɔbɛdi nkonim no, wɔbɛhyɛ no atadeɛ fitaa, na merentwa ne din mfiri ateasefoɔ nwoma no mu. Na mɛda ne din adi wɔ mʼAgya no ne nʼabɔfoɔ anim sɛ ɔyɛ me dea.
3.6: Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no ka kyerɛ asafo no.
3.7: “Twerɛ krataa yi kɔma ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔwɔ asafo a ɛwɔ Filadelfia no sɛ: Yei ne asɛm a ɛfiri deɛ ɔyɛ kronkron na ɔyɛ nokorɛ na ɔkura Dawid safoa no nkyɛn. Deɛ ɔbue a, obi ntumi nto mu na sɛ ɔto mu nso a, obi ntumi mmue no.
3.8: Menim deɛ woyɛ. Menim sɛ wowɔ tumi kakra. Woadi me nkyerɛkyerɛ no so, nam so adi me nokorɛ. Mabue ɛpono bi wɔ wʼanim a obi ntumi nto mu.
3.9: Tie! Ekuo a ɔbonsam afa wɔn no, saa atorofoɔ a wɔka sɛ wɔyɛ Yudafoɔ nanso wɔnyɛ bi no, mɛma wɔaba wʼanim abɛbu wo nkotodwe. Wɔn nyinaa bɛhunu sɛ medɔ wo.
3.10: Esiane sɛ woadi me mmara so anya boasetɔ enti, sɛ ɔhaw a ɛreba ewiase nyinaa de asɔ asase so nnipa nyinaa ahwɛ no ba a, mɛgye wo afiri mu.
3.11: Mereba nnansa yi ara. Kora wʼagyapadeɛ, na obi anwia wo nkonim abotire no.
3.12: Deɛ ɔbɛdi nkonim no, mɛyɛ no odum me Onyankopɔn asɔredan mu, na ɔremfiri mu bio da. Mɛtwerɛ me Onyankopɔn din ne me Onyankopɔn kuro din a ɛyɛ Yerusalem foforɔ a ɛbɛfiri ɔsoro me Onyankopɔn nkyɛn aba no agu ne ho. Bio, mɛtwerɛ me din foforɔ agu ne ho.
3.13: Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no ka kyerɛ asafo no.
3.14: “Twerɛ krataa yi kɔma ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔwɔ Laodikea asafo mu no sɛ: Yei ne asɛm a ɛfiri Amen a ɔyɛ ɔdanseni nokwafoɔ a ɔyɛ biribiara a Onyankopɔn bɔeɛ no sodifoɔ nkyɛn.
3.15: Menim deɛ woayɛ. Menim sɛ wonyɛ nwunu nso wonyɛ hye. Me pɛ ne sɛ, anka wobɛyɛ mu baako.
3.16: Nanso, ɛsiane sɛ woyɛ boturobodwo, na wonyɛ hye na wonyɛ nwunu enti, merebɛte wo sɛ ntasuo afiri mʼanom.
3.17: Woka sɛ, ‘meyɛ ɔdefoɔ na manya me ho na mewɔ deɛ ɛhia me nyinaa.’ Nanso, wonnim hia a ahia wo ne mmɔborɔ a woyɛ. Woyɛ ohiani. Woda adagya, na wʼani afira.
3.18: Enti, metu wo fo sɛ tɔ sikakɔkɔɔ, sikakɔkɔɔ amapa, firi me nkyɛn, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛma woayɛ ɔdefoɔ. Afei, tɔ ntadeɛ fitaa hyɛ fa kata wʼanimguaseɛ adagya no so. Afei, tɔ aduro gu wʼani so, sɛdeɛ wobɛhunu adeɛ.
3.19: Mekɔ so twe wɔn a medɔ wɔn no nyinaa aso. Enti bɔ mmɔden na twe wo ho firi bɔne ho.
3.20: Tie! Megyina ɛpono no akyi rebɔ mu; sɛ obi te me nne na ɔbue ɛpono no a, mɛba mu na me ne no adidi na ɔno nso ne me adidi.
3.21: Mɛma nkonimdifoɔ no atena mʼahennwa no ho, sɛdeɛ madi nkonim enti, mete mʼAgya ahennwa ho seesei no.
3.22: Sɛ wowɔ aso a, ɛnneɛ tie deɛ Honhom no ka kyerɛ asafo no.”

4.1: Yei akyiri no, mehwɛ mehunuu ɛpono a abue wɔ ɔsoro. Na ɛnne bi akasa akyerɛ me pɛn na ɛgyegye sɛ totorobɛnto kaa sɛ, “Bra ɔsoro ha, na mɛkyerɛ wo deɛ ɛbɛba yei akyi.”
4.2: Prɛko pɛ, na Honhom no faa me. Na ahennwa bi si ɔsoro hɔ a obi te so.
4.3: Na nʼanim hyerɛn te sɛ ahwehwɛboɔ ne mogyanamboɔ. Na nyankontɔn a ɛte sɛ ahahammonoboɔ atwa ahennwa no ho ahyia.
4.4: Na ahennwa nketewa aduonu nan atwa ahennwa kɛseɛ no ho ahyia a mpanimfoɔ aduonu ɛnan na wɔtete so a wɔhyehyɛ ntadeɛ fitaa ne sikakɔkɔɔ ahenkyɛ.
4.5: Na anyinam ne aprannaa bobom firi ahennwa no mu. Na nkanea nson a wɔasosɔ redɛre wɔ ahennwa no anim. Yeinom yɛ Onyankopɔn ahonhom nson.
4.6: Na biribi te sɛ ahwehwɛ ɛpo a ɛyɛ korɔgyenn sɛ ahwehwɛ da ahennwa no anim. Ahennwa no fa biara, na ateasefoɔ baanan a ani tuatua wɔn anim ne wɔn akyi atwa ahennwa no ho ahyia.
4.7: Na ɔteasefoɔ a ɔdi ɛkan no te sɛ gyata; deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu no te sɛ nantwie ba; deɛ ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa no anim te sɛ onipa; ɛnna deɛ ɔtɔ so nan no te sɛ ɔkɔdeɛ a ɔretu.
4.8: Na ateasefoɔ baanan no mu biara wɔ ntaban nsia a ani tuatua akyire ne animu nyinaa. Anadwo ne awia nyinaa na wɔto dwom sɛ,
4.9: Saa ateasefoɔ baanan no to nnwom de hyɛ deɛ ɔte ahennwa no so a ɔte hɔ daa daa no animuonyam, de ma no anidie, da no ase. Sɛ wɔyɛ saa a,
4.10: mpanimfoɔ aduonu ɛnan no butubutu deɛ ɔte ahennwa no so no anim som deɛ ɔte hɔ daa daa no. Wɔto wɔn ahenkyɛ gu ahennwa no anim ka sɛ:
4.11: “Yɛn Awurade ne Onyankopɔn, wofata sɛ wonya animuonyam, anidie ne tumi, ɛfiri sɛ, wo na wobɔɔ nneɛma nyinaa, na wo pɛ mu enti na wɔte hɔ.”

5.1: Mehunuu sɛ deɛ ɔte ahennwa so no kura nwoma bi wɔ ne nsa nifa mu. Na wɔatwerɛ akyire ne animu nyinaa a wɔde nsɔano nson asosɔ ano.
5.2: Mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ hoɔdenfoɔ bi a ɔde nne kɛseɛ kaa sɛ, “Hwan na ɔfata sɛ ɔte nsɔano no na ɔbue nwoma no mu?”
5.3: Nanso, wɔannya obiara a ɔwɔ ɔsoro anaa asase so anaa asase ase a ɔtumi buee nwoma no mu hwɛɛ mu.
5.4: Mesuu yie, ɛfiri sɛ wɔannya obiara a ɔfata sɛ ɔbue nwoma no mu na ɔhwɛ mu.
5.5: Afei, ɔpanin baako ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, “Nsu. Hwɛ! Gyata a ɔfiri Yuda abusuakuo mu a ɔyɛ Dawid aseni adi nkonim, na ɔbɛtumi atete nsɔano nson no na wabue nwoma no mu.”
5.6: Afei, mehunuu Odwammaa bi sɛ ɔgyina ahennwa no mfimfini a ateasefoɔ baanan no ne mpanimfoɔ no atwa ne ho ahyia. Wɔhwɛ a na ɛsɛ deɛ wɔakum Odwammaa no. Na ɔwɔ mmɛn nson ne aniwa nson a ɛgyina hɔ ma Onyankopɔn ahonhom nson no a wɔasoma wɔn aba ewiase no.
5.7: Odwammaa no kɔgyee nwoma no firii deɛ ɔte ahennwa so no nsa nifa mu.
5.8: Ɔyɛɛ saa no, ateasefoɔ baanan no ne mpanimfoɔ aduonu ɛnan no butubutuu Odwammaa no anim. Na wɔn mu biara kura sankuo ne sika ayowaa a aduhwam ayɛ no ma a ɛyɛ ahotefoɔ mpaeɛ.
5.9: Wɔtoo dwom foforɔ sɛ, “Wofata sɛ wofa nwoma no na wote ne nsɔano no, ɛfiri sɛ wɔkumm wo, na ɛnam wo wuo so maa wɔtɔɔ nnipa firii aman ne mmusuakuo ne nkurɔfoɔ ne kasa nyinaa mu maa Onyankopɔn.
5.10: Wɔayɛ wɔn asɔfoɔ ahemman sɛ wɔnsom yɛn Onyankopɔn na wɔbɛdi asase so ɔhene.”
5.11: Bio mehwɛeɛ, tee abɔfoɔ mpempem nka. Na wɔatwa ahennwa no ne ateasefoɔ baanan no ne mpanimfoɔ no ho ahyia
5.12: reto dwom denden sɛ, “Odwammaa a wɔkumm no no fata sɛ ɔgye tumi, ahonya, nyansa ne ahoɔden ne anidie ne animuonyam ne nkamfoɔ!”
5.13: Na metee sɛ abɔdeɛ a wɔwɔ ɔsoro, asase so, asase ase ne abɔdeɛ biara a wɔwɔ ɛpo mu ne abɔdeɛ biara a wɔwɔ ewiase nyinaa reto dwom sɛ, “Nhyira ne anidie ne animuonyam ne tumi, nka deɛ ɔte ahennwa no so ne Odwammaa no,
5.14: Abɔdeɛ ɛnan no gyee so sɛ, “Amen!” Na mpanimfoɔ no butubutuu hɔ someeɛ.

6.1: Afei, mehunuu sɛ Odwammaa no ate nsɔano nson no mu deɛ ɛdi ɛkan ano, na metee sɛ ateasefoɔ baanan no mu baako de nne a ɛte sɛ aprannaa reka sɛ, “Bra!”
6.2: Mehwɛeɛ, na mehunuu ɔpɔnkɔ fitaa bi wɔ hɔ. Na deɛ ɔte ne so no kura agyan na wɔmaa no ahenkyɛ. Ɔkɔeɛ sɛ nkonimdifoɔ kɔdii nkonim.
6.3: Afei, Odwammaa no tee nsɔano a ɛtɔ so mmienu no ano, na metee sɛ ɔteasefoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmienu no reka sɛ, “Bra!”
6.4: Ɔpɔnkɔ foforɔ a ɔyɛ kɔkɔɔ baeɛ. Wɔmaa deɛ ɔte ne so no tumi sɛ ɔmfa ɔko mmra asase so na nnipa nkunkum wɔn ho. Wɔmaa no akofena kɛseɛ bi.
6.5: Afei, Odwammaa no tee nsɔano a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no ano, na metee sɛ ɔteasefoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa no reka sɛ, “Bra!” Mehwɛeɛ, na mehunuu ɔpɔnkɔ tuntum bi wɔ hɔ. Ne kafoɔ no kura nsania mmienu.
6.6: Metee biribi te sɛ nne bi firi ateasefoɔ baanan no nkyɛn. Na nne no se, “Ayuo susukora yɛ ɛda koro akatua, ɛnna aburoo susukora mmiɛnsa nso yɛ ɛda koro akatua. Nanso, nsɛe nsrango no ne bobesa no!”
6.7: Afei, Odwammaa no tee nsɔano a ɛtɔ so nan no ano na metee sɛ ɔteasefoɔ a ɔtɔ so nan no reka sɛ, “Bra!”
6.8: Mehwɛeɛ na mehunuu ɔpɔnkɔ nsonso bi. Wɔtoo ne sotefoɔ no din “Owuo”, na Asaman di nʼakyi pɛɛ. Wɔmaa no asase nkyɛmu nan mu baako so tumi sɛ ɔmfa ɔko, ɔkɔm, yadeɛ ne nkekaboa a wɔwɔ asase so nkunkum wɔn.
6.9: Afei Odwammaa no tee nsɔano a ɛtɔ so enum no ano. Mehunuu afɔrebukyia bi, na aseɛ na wɔn a wɔkumm wɔn wɔ asɛnka no ho na wɔde gyidie dii adanseɛ no akra wɔ.
6.10: Wɔde nne a ano yɛ den kaa sɛ, “Otumfoɔ Awurade, Ɔkronkronni ne Nokwafoɔ! Woretwɛn akɔsi da bɛn ansa na wɔabu nnipa a wɔwɔ asase so atɛn, na wɔatwe wɔn aso sɛ wɔkunkum yɛn?”
6.11: Wɔmaa wɔn mu biara atadeɛ fitaa, na wɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔntwɛn kakra kɔsi sɛ wɔbɛkum wɔn nuanom asomfoɔ abɛka wɔn ho.
6.12: Na mehunuu sɛ Odwammaa no tee nsɔano a ɛtɔ so nsia no ano. Na asasewosoɔ a ano yɛ den baeɛ maa owia yɛɛ tumm sɛ ayitoma, na ɔsrane yɛɛ kɔɔ sɛ mogya.
6.13: Na nsoromma tete firii soro bɛhwee asase so te sɛ deɛ mframa a ano yɛ den bɔ borɔdɔma bunu ma ɛtete gu fam pɛ.
6.14: Ɔsoro yeraeɛ te sɛ nwoma a wɔabobɔ, na mmepɔ ne nsupɔ firii wɔn atenaeɛ.
6.15: Na asase so ahemfo ne nnipa akɛseɛ ne asafohene ne adefoɔ ne ahoɔdenfoɔ ne nkoa ne adehyeɛ nyinaa hintahintaa abodan ne mmepɔ mu abotan mu.
6.16: Na wɔka kyerɛɛ mmepɔ no ne abotan no sɛ, “Monkata yɛn so na momfa yɛn nsie, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, deɛ ɔte ahennwa no so no ani renhunu yɛn, na yɛmfiri Odwammaa no abufuo ano.
6.17: Wɔn abufuo no ɛda kɛseɛ aduru, na hwan na ɔbɛtumi agyina ano?”

7.1: Yei akyi no, mehunuu abɔfoɔ baanan sɛ, wɔgyinagyina asase ntweaa nan no so a wɔretwe mframa nan a ɛwɔ asase so no, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a mframa biara remmɔ wɔ asase ne ɛpo so ne baabiara.
7.2: Ɛnna mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ a ɔfiri apueeɛ reba a ɔkura Onyankopɔn a ɔte ase no nsɔano. Ɔteaam frɛɛ abɔfoɔ baanan no a na Onyankopɔn ama wɔn tumi sɛ wɔnsɛe asase ne ɛpo no.
7.3: Ɔbɔfoɔ no kaa sɛ, “Monnsɛe asase ne ɛpo anaa nnua kɔsi sɛ yɛde nsɔano bɛhyɛ Onyankopɔn asomfoɔ no agyiraeɛ.”
7.4: Na wɔkyerɛɛ me wɔn a wɔde Onyankopɔn nsɔano hyɛɛ wɔn agyiraeɛ wɔ wɔn moma so no dodoɔ. Wɔn nyinaa dodoɔ yɛ ɔpeha aduanan ɛnan, a wɔn nyinaa firi Israel mmusuakuo no mu.
7.5: Yuda abusuakuo mu nnipa a wɔsɔɔ wɔn ano si mpem dumienu [(12,000)]. Ruben abusuakuo mu nnipa a wɔsɔɔ wɔn ano si mpem dumienu [(12,000)]. Gad abusuakuo mu nnipa a wɔsɔɔ wɔn ano si mpem dumienu [(12,000)].
7.6: Aser abusuakuo mu nnipa a wɔsɔɔ wɔn ano si mpem dumienu [(12,000)]. Naftali abusuakuo mu nnipa a wɔsɔɔ wɔn ano si mpem dumienu [(12,000)]. Manase abusuakuo mu nnipa a wɔsɔɔ wɔn ano si mpem dumienu [(12,000)].
7.7: Simeon abusuakuo mu nnipa a wɔsɔɔ wɔn ano si mpem dumienu [(12,000)]. Lewi abusuakuo mu nnipa a wɔsɔɔ wɔn ano si mpem dumienu [(12,000)]. Isakar abusuakuo mu nnipa a wɔsɔɔ wɔn ano si mpem dumienu [(12,000)].
7.8: Sebulon abusuakuo mu nnipa a wɔsɔɔ wɔn ano si mpem dumienu [(12,000)]. Yosef abusuakuo mu nnipa a wɔsɔɔ wɔn ano si mpem dumienu [(12,000)]. Benyamin abusuakuo mu nnipa a wɔsɔɔ wɔn ano si mpem dumienu [(12,000)].
7.9: Yei akyi no, mehunuu nnipakuo a obiara ntumi nkan wɔn dodoɔ. Wɔfifiri aman ne mmusuakuo ne nkurɔfoɔ ne kasa nyinaa mu a wɔgyinagyina ahennwa no ne Odwammaa no anim a wɔhyehyɛ ntadeɛ fitafitaa, kurakura berɛ.
7.10: Wɔteaam sɛ, “Yɛn nkwagyeɛ firi yɛn Onyankopɔn a ɔte ahennwa no so ne Odwammaa no.”
7.11: Na abɔfoɔ no atwa ahennwa no ne mpanimfoɔ no ne ateasefoɔ baanan no ho ahyia. Afei wɔbutubutuu ahennwa no anim, somm Onyankopɔn
7.12: kaa sɛ, “Amen! Nhyira ne animuonyam ne nyansa ne aseda ne anidie ne tumi ne ahoɔden yɛ Onyankopɔn dea daa daa. Amen!”
7.13: Mpanimfoɔ no mu baako bisaa me sɛ, “Ɛhefoɔ na wɔhyehyɛ ntadeɛ fitafitaa yi, na wɔfiri he?”
7.14: Mebuaa sɛ, “Mennim, owura. Na wo na wonim.” Ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, “Yeinom ne wɔn a wɔafiri ɔtaa mu. Wɔde Odwammaa no mogya ahoro wɔn ntadeɛ ama ayɛ fitaa.
7.15: Na ɛno enti na, “wɔgyina Onyankopɔn ahennwa anim a wɔresom awia ne anadwo wɔ ne hyiadan mu yi. Deɛ ɔbɛtena ahennwa no so no bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban.
7.16: Sukɔm renne wɔn bio; ɛkɔm renne wɔn bio. Owia anaa ɔhyew biara renhye wɔn bio.
7.17: Ɛfiri sɛ, Odwammaa no a ɔwɔ ahennwa no mfimfini no bɛyɛ wɔn dwanhwɛfoɔ de wɔn akɔ nkwa asutire ho. Na Onyankopɔn bɛpepa wɔn aniwa mu nisuo nyinaa.”

8.1: Ɛberɛ a Odwammaa no tee nsɔano a ɛtɔ so nson no, ɔsoro nyinaa tɛm dinn bɛyɛ dɔnhwereɛ fa.
8.2: Afei mehunuu abɔfoɔ baason a wɔgyinagyina Onyankopɔn anim. Wɔmemaa wɔn ntotorobɛnto nson.
8.3: Ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ a na ɔwɔ sikakɔkɔɔ aduhwam adaka bɛgyinaa afɔrebukyia no ho. Wɔmaa no aduhwam bebree sɛ ɔmfa mmɔ mpaeɛ nka Onyankopɔn nkurɔfoɔ no deɛ ho, na ɔmmɔ sikakɔkɔɔ a ɛsi ahennwa no anim no so afɔdeɛ.
8.4: Aduhwam no hwa ne Onyankopɔn nkurɔfoɔ mpaeɛ firi abɔfoɔ no nsam kɔɔ soro.
8.5: Afei, ɔbɔfoɔ no faa aduhwam adaka no de ogya a ɛfiri afɔrebukyia no so hyɛɛ no ma, to twenee asase so. Na aprannaa ne nne ahodoɔ ne anyinam ne asasewosoɔ baeɛ.
8.6: Na abɔfoɔ baason a wɔkurakura ntotorobɛnto nson no siesiee wɔn ho sɛ wɔrebɛhyɛne.
8.7: Ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔdi ɛkan no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto. Na asukɔtweaa ne ogya a ɛne mogya adi afra tɔ guu asase so. Asase nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako hyeeɛ. Nnua nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako hyeeɛ, ɛnna wira mono nyinaa nso hyeeɛ.
8.8: Afei, ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmienu no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto. Wɔtoo biribi a ɛte sɛ bepɔ kɛseɛ a ɛrederɛ twenee ɛpo mu. Ɛpo no nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako danee mogya.
8.9: Na abɔdeɛ a ɛwɔ nkwa a ɛwɔ ɛpo no mu nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako wuwuiɛ maa ahyɛn mu nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako bobɔeɛ.
8.10: Afei, ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto. Nsoromma kɛseɛ bi a ɛrederɛ sɛ egyatɛn te firi soro bɛhwee nsuo nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako mu.
8.11: Nsoromma no din de “Ɔnwono”. Nsuo no nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako yɛɛ nwono, na nnipa a wɔnomeeɛ no mu bebree wuwuiɛ ɛfiri sɛ, na ayɛ nwono.
8.12: Afei, ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nan no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto. Na wɔbɔɔ owia nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako, ne ɔsrane nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako ne nsoromma nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako seneeɛ maa no duduruu sum, enti adekyeeɛ mu nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako anhyerɛn, na anadwo nso saa ara.
8.13: Na mehwɛeɛ na metee sɛ ɔkɔdeɛ bi a watu nam soro soro teaam sɛ, “Wɔn a wɔte asase so no nnue; wɔnnue, wɔnnue ɛsiane totorobɛnto a aka a abɔfoɔ baasa no rebɛhyɛn no enti.”

9.1: Afei ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so enum no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto. Mehunuu nsoromma a wate firi soro abɛhwe asase so. Wɔmaa no ebunu a ase nni awieeɛ safoa.
9.2: Nsoromma no buee ebunu no, na wisie kumɔnn firii mu sɛ fononoo kɛseɛ bi, na wisie no maa owia hann ne mframa a ɛwɔ hɔ no yɛɛ tumm.
9.3: Mmoadabi firii wisie no mu baa asase so, na wɔmaa wɔn tumi sɛ anyanyankyerɛ.
9.4: Wɔama wɔn ansɛe ɛserɛ anaa nnua anaa afifideɛ biara, na mmom, nnipa a Onyankopɔn nsɔano no bi nni wɔn moma so no deɛ, wɔmaa wɔn twee wɔn aso.
9.5: Wɔamma saa mmoadabi no ɛkwan sɛ wɔnkunkum saa nnipa yi. Na mmom, wɔmaa wɔn ɛkwan sɛ wɔnha wɔn abosome enum. Wɔka wɔn a, wɔn ano yea no te sɛ nyanyankyerɛ deɛ.
9.6: Saa abosome enum no mu no, saa nnipa no bɛpere owuo, nanso wɔrennya. Wɔbɛpɛ sɛ wɔwu, nanso owuo bɛdwane afiri wɔn nkyɛn.
9.7: Mmoadabi no te sɛ apɔnkɔ a wɔasiesie wɔn ama ɔko. Wɔwɔ biribi te sɛ sikakɔkɔɔ ahenkyɛ hyɛ wɔn ti. Na wɔn anim te sɛ nnipa anim.
9.8: Wɔn tirinwi te sɛ mmaa tirinwi, ɛnna wɔn se nso te sɛ gyata se.
9.9: Wɔde biribi te sɛ dadeɛ nkataboɔ akatakata wɔn bo. Na nnyegyeeɛ a wɔn ntaban yɛ no te sɛ apɔnkɔ bebree a wɔretwe nteaseɛnam akɔ ɔko.
9.10: Wɔwɔ borɔ dua te sɛ anyanyankyerɛ. Na wɔn dua no enti na na wɔwɔ tumi a wɔde ha nnipa abosome enum no.
9.11: Wɔwɔ ɔhene a ɔdi wɔn so, a ɔno ne ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔhwɛ bunu no so. Ne din wɔ Hebri kasa mu de “Abadon” ɛnna Hela kasa mu nso, ɛde “Apolion”, a nʼasekyerɛ ne “Ɔsɛefoɔ.”
9.12: Ɔhaw baako atwam. Yei akyi, ɔhaw mmienu bi bɛba.
9.13: Afei ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nsia no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto. Metee nne bi firii sikakɔkɔɔ afɔrebukyia a ɛsi Onyankopɔn anim no ntweaso nyinaa.
9.14: Nne no ka kyerɛɛ ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nsia a ɔkura totorobɛnto no sɛ, “Sanesane abɔfoɔ baanan a wɔasesa wɔn, Asubɔnten Eufrate ho no.”
9.15: Wɔsanesanee abɔfoɔ baanan no. Wɔasiesie wɔn ama saa dɔnhwereɛ yi, saa da yi, saa bosome yi ne saa afeɛ yi sɛ wɔnkunkum adasamma mu nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako.
9.16: Wɔdii akodɔm ɔpepem ahanu anim. Wɔbɔɔ wɔn dodoɔ no ho amaneɛ maa meteeɛ.
9.17: Na mʼanisoadehunu no mu no, mehunuu apɔnkɔ no ne wɔn kafoɔ. Na wɔn nkataboɔ no yɛ kɔɔ sɛ ogya, tumm sɛ afasebire, ɛnna akokɔsradeɛ sɛ sɔfe. Na ɔpɔnkɔ no ti te sɛ gyata ti a ogya wisie ne sɔfe firi wɔn anom.
9.18: Saa ɔhaw ahodoɔ mmiɛnsa no a ɛyɛ ogya, wisie ne sɔfe no a ɛfiri apɔnkɔ no anom baeɛ no kumm adasamma nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako.
9.19: Ɛfiri sɛ, na apɔnkɔ no tumi nyinaa firi wɔn anom ne wɔn dua. Wɔn dua te sɛ awɔ a wɔwɔ ti a ɛno na na wɔde pira nnipa.
9.20: Adasamma a wɔkaeɛ no a ɔhaw no ankum wɔn no annu wɔn ho amfiri wɔn nsa ano nnwuma ho. Wɔannyae ahonhommɔne ne ahoni ne sika ne dwetɛ ne ayowaa ne aboɔ ne nnua a ɛnhunu adeɛ na ɛnte asɛm na ɛntumi nnante no som.
9.21: Saa ara nso na wɔannu wɔn ho amfiri wɔn awudie ne wɔn adutoɔ ne wɔn adwamammɔ ne wɔn korɔno ho.

10.1: Afei, mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ hoɔdenfoɔ foforɔ bi a ɔfiri ɔsoro resiane ba fam. Na ɔhyɛ omununkum mu a nyankontɔn bɔ ne ti. Na nʼanim te sɛ owia, na ne nan te sɛ ogya fadum.
10.2: Na nwoma ketewaa bi kura no a wabue mu. Ɔde ne nan nifa sii ɛpo so na benkum no si asase so.
10.3: Ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaam sɛdeɛ gyata bobom. Ɔteaam no, aprannaa nson kasaeɛ.
10.4: Wɔkasaeɛ pɛ, na mepɛ sɛ metwerɛ. Nanso, metee nne bi firii ɔsoro a ɛkaa sɛ, “Ma nsɛm a aprannaa nson no kaeɛ no nka wo tirim. Ntwerɛ!”
10.5: Ɛhɔ ara ɔbɔfoɔ a mehunuu sɛ ɔgyina hɔ a ne nan baako si ɛpo so na baako si asase so no maa ne nsa nifa so kɔɔ soro,
10.6: na ɔde Onyankopɔn a ɔte hɔ daa daa a ɔbɔɔ ɔsoro ne asase ne ɛpo ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa no edin kaa ntam. Ɔbɔfoɔ no kaa sɛ, “Ɛberɛ sɛeɛ biara nni hɔ.
10.7: Na sɛ ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nson no hyɛne ne totorobɛnto no a ansa na Onyankopɔn bɛwie nʼahintasɛm mu nhyehyɛeɛ no, sɛdeɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ nʼasomfoɔ a wɔyɛ adiyifoɔ no.”
10.8: Afei, nne a metee sɛ ɛfiri ɔsoro no kasa kyerɛɛ me bio sɛ. “Kɔ na kɔgye nwoma a wabue mu a ɛkura ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔgyina ɛpo ne asase so no.”
10.9: Mekɔɔ ɔbɔfoɔ no nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ ɔmfa nwoma ketewa no mma me. Ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, “Gye na kɔwe. Ɛbɛkeka wɔ wo yam, nanso wʼanomu deɛ, ɛbɛyɛ dɛ te sɛ ɛwoɔ.”
10.10: Megyee nwoma ketewa no firii ne nsam weeɛ, na ɛyɛɛ dɛ te sɛ ɛwoɔ wɔ mʼanom. Nanso, memeneeɛ no akyi, ɛmaa me yam kaa me.
10.11: Afei, wɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, “Kɔ so ka deɛ ɛbɛba kyerɛ aman bebree sofoɔ, kasa ahodoɔ ne ahemfo nso.”

11.1: Wɔmaa me susudua bi a ɛte sɛ poma, na wɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, “Sɔre na susu Onyankopɔn asɔredan no ne afɔrebukyia no na kan wɔn a wɔresom wɔ asɔredan no mu no.
11.2: Nanso, mfa asɔredan no adihɔ nka ho, ɛfiri sɛ, wɔde hɔ ama amanamanmufoɔ, na wɔbɛtiatia kuro kronkron no so abosome aduanan mmienu.
11.3: Mɛsoma mʼadansefoɔ baanu a wɔfirafira ayitoma, na wɔaka Onyankopɔn asɛm saa nna apem ahanu ne aduosia no mu.”
11.4: Saa adansefoɔ baanu no ne ngo dua mmienu no ne nkaneadua mmienu a ɛsi asase a ɛwɔ Awurade anim no so no.
11.5: Egya firi wɔn anom bɛkunkum atamfoɔ biara a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔha wɔn no. Ɛno enti, obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔha wɔn no, wɔbɛkum no.
11.6: Wɔwɔ tumi sɛ ɛberɛ a wɔreka Onyankopɔn asɛm no, wɔto soro mu, a osuo rentɔ. Wɔwɔ tumi sɛ wɔde ɔhaw bɛto asase so mpɛn dodoɔ biara a wɔpɛ.
11.7: Na sɛ wɔka wɔn asɛm no wie a, aboa a ɔbɛfiri bunu no mu apue no ne wɔn bɛko. Ɔbɛdi wɔn so akum wɔn
11.8: na wɔn amu no agu kuro kɛseɛ no abɔntene so, wɔ baabi a wɔbɔɔ wɔn Awurade nnadewa mu wɔ asɛnnua no so a ɛhɔ din pa de Sodom ne Misraim no.
11.9: Na nnipa a wɔfiri aman so ne mmusuakuo ne kasa ahodoɔ ne aman bi so bɛhwɛ wɔn afunu nnansa ne fa, na wɔremma ɛkwan mma wɔnsie wɔn.
11.10: Asase so nnipa ani bɛgye sɛ saa nnipa baanu no awuwu. Wɔbɛgye wɔn ani na wɔakyɛ wɔn ho akyɛdeɛ ɛfiri sɛ, saa adiyifoɔ baanu no na wɔde ɔhaw bɛtoo asase sofoɔ so.
11.11: Nanso, nnansa akyi no, Honhom a ɔfiri Onyankopɔn hɔ bɛwura wɔn mu na wɔasɔre. Na ehu kɛseɛ bɛka obiara a ɔbɛhunu.
11.12: Afei, nne a ano yɛ den firi ɔsoro bɛka sɛ, “Mommra ɔsoro ha.” Na ɛberɛ a wɔn atamfoɔ rehwɛ wɔn no, wɔnam omununkum mu kɔɔ ɔsoro.
11.13: Saa ɛberɛ korɔ no ara mu, asase wosoo dendeenden. Kuro no nkyɛmu edu mu baako sɛeɛ, na nnipa mpemnson wuwuiɛ wɔ asasewosoɔ no mu. Nnipa a wɔaka no bɔɔ hu na wɔkamfoo Onyankopɔn a ɔwɔ ɔsoro no kɛseyɛ.
11.14: Ɔhaw a ɛtɔ so mmienu no atwa, nanso hwɛ, ɛrenkyɛre na ɔhaw a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa aba.
11.15: Afei, ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nson hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto, na nne denden wɔ ɔsoro kaa sɛ, “Tumi a wɔde di ewiase so seesei no yɛ yɛn Awurade ne ne Kristo no dea, na ɔbɛdi ɔhene daa daa.”
11.16: Afei, mpanimfoɔ aduonu ɛnan a wɔte wɔn ahennwa so Onyankopɔn anim no de wɔn anim butubutu fam, somm Onyankopɔn,
11.17: kaa sɛ, “Yɛda wo ase, Otumfoɔ Onyankopɔn, wo a wowɔ hɔ na wowɔ hɔ dada, sɛ woafa wo tumi kɛseɛ, na wahyɛ aseɛ redi ɔhene.
11.18: Amanaman no bo fuiɛ, ɛfiri sɛ wʼabofuo berɛ no aduru a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbu awufoɔ atɛn. Ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wobɔ wo nkoa adiyifoɔ no aba so ne wo nkurɔfoɔ a wɔdi wo din ni no, akɛseɛ ne nketewa. Ɛberɛ aduru sɛ wosɛe wɔn a wɔsɛee asase no!”
11.19: Onyankopɔn asɔredan a ɛwɔ ɔsoro no bueɛ maa wɔhunuu adaka a apam no wɔ mu no wɔ asɔredan no mu. Afei, anyinam ne aprannaa paapaee, ɛnna asase wosoeɛ na asukɔtweaa bebree nso tɔeɛ.

12.1: Afei, nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ kɛseɛ bi daa ne ho adi wɔ ɔsoro. Ɔbaa bi, na nʼatadeɛ yɛ owia a ɔsrane wɔ ne nan ase, na nsoromma dumienu ahenkyɛ hyɛ no.
12.2: Na ɔnyem a ɔrebɛwo, na awoyea enti, na ɔresu.
12.3: Nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ kɛseɛ foforɔ bi daa ne ho adi wɔ ɔsoro. Ɔwɔ kɔkɔɔ kakraka bi, na ne ti yɛ nson na ɔwɔ mmɛn edu a ahenkyɛ hyehyɛ ebiara so.
12.4: Ɔde ne dua twee nsoromma a ɛwɔ ɔsoro no mu nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako too wɔn guu fam. Ɔgyinaa ɔbaa a ɔrewo no anim, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɔwo ɔba no to hɔ ara pɛ, ɔbɛfa abɔfra no awe.
12.5: Afei, ɔbaa no woo abarimaa a ɔde nsa a ɛyɛ den bɛdi aman nyinaa so. Nanso, wɔhwim abɔfra no kɔɔ Onyankopɔn ne nʼahennwa ho.
12.6: Ɔbaa no dwane kɔɔ ɛserɛ so baabi a Onyankopɔn asiesie ama no a wɔbɛhwɛ no yie wɔ nnafua apem ahanu ne aduosia mu.
12.7: Afei, ɔko sii ɔsoro hɔ. Mikael ne nʼabɔfoɔ ko tiaa ɔwɔ no, ɛnna ɔno nso ne nʼabɔfoɔ ko tiaeɛ.
12.8: Nanso, wɔdii ɔwɔ no so nkonim na wɔamma ɔne nʼabɔfoɔ antena ɔsoro bio.
12.9: Wɔtoo ɔwɔ kakraka no tweneeɛ. Ɔno ne ɔwɔ dada no a wɔfrɛ no ɔbonsam a ɔdaadaa ewiase nyinaa no. Wɔtoo ɔno ne nʼabɔfoɔ nyinaa guu asase so.
12.10: Afei, metee nne denden bi wɔ ɔsoro a ɛka sɛ, “Afei, na Onyankopɔn nkwagyeɛ aba! Afei, na Onyankopɔn akyerɛ ne tumi sɛ ɔyɛ Ɔhene! Afei, na nʼAgyenkwa no akyerɛ ne tumi, ɛfiri sɛ, yɛn nuanom no ahohorabɔni a ɔgyinaa Onyankopɔn anim bɔɔ wɔn ahohora awia ne anadwo no, wɔapam no afiri soro no.
12.11: Yɛn nuanom no nam Odwammaa no mogya so ne nokorɛ a ɔdaa no adi so dii ne so nkonim. Na wɔasiesie wɔn ho sɛ wɔde wɔn nkwa bɛto hɔ na wɔawuwu.
12.12: Enti, mo ɔsoro ne mo a motete hɔ no, momma mo ani nnye. Afei, asase ne ɛpo nnue! Ɛfiri sɛ, ɔbonsam no atoa mo! Na ne bo afu, ɛfiri sɛ, ɔnim sɛ ne ɛberɛ a aka sua.”
12.13: Ɛberɛ a ɔwɔ no hunuu sɛ wɔato no atwene asase so no, ɔtaa ɔbaa a wawo abarimaa no.
12.14: Wɔmaa ɔbaa no ɔkɔdeɛ ntaban akɛseɛ mmienu, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɔbɛtumi atu akɔ baabi a wɔasiesie ama no wɔ ɛserɛ so hɔ a wɔbɛhwɛ no mfeɛ mmiɛnsa ne fa sɛdeɛ ɔwɔ no renni nʼakyi bio.
12.15: Afei, ɔwɔ no puu nsuo te sɛ asubɔnten dii ɔbaa no akyi sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, ɛbɛfa no.
12.16: Nanso, asase boaa ɔbaa no. Ɛbuee nʼanom nom nsuo a ɔwɔ no pu guu hɔ no nyinaa.
12.17: Ɔwɔ no bo fuu ɔbaa no, enti ɔkɔeɛ de ntɔkwa kɔkaa ɔbaa no asefoɔ a wɔaka a ɛyɛ wɔn a wɔdi Onyankopɔn mmara so na wɔgye nokorɛ a Yesu ada no adi no di.
12.18: Na ɔwɔ no kɔgyinaa mpoano hɔ.

13.1: Afei, mehunuu sɛ aboa bi apue ɛpo no mu reba. Na ɔwɔ mmɛn edu ne tire nson a na ahenkyɛ hyehyɛ mmɛn no biara so na edin a ɛgu Onyankopɔn ho fi bobɔ etire no ho.
13.2: Aboa a mehunuu no no, na ɔte sɛ ɔsebɔ a ne nan te sɛ sisi, na nʼano nso te sɛ gyata. Ɔtweaseɛ no de ɔno ankasa ahoɔden ne nʼahennwa ne ne tumi nyinaa maa aboa no.
13.3: Mehunuu sɛ wɔapira ne tiri no baako a ayɛ sɛ wɔrentumi nkum kuro no, nanso na kuro no awu. Aboa no ho yɛɛ ewiasefoɔ nyinaa nwanwa, enti wɔtu dii nʼakyi.
13.4: Nnipa nyinaa somm ɔtweaseɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ, ɔde ne tumi nyinaa ama aboa no. Wɔsomm aboa no nso kaa sɛ, “Hwan na ɔte sɛ aboa no? Na hwan na ɔbɛtumi ne no ako?”
13.5: Wɔmaa aboa no kwan maa ɔkaa abususɛm akɛseakɛseɛ tiaa Onyankopɔn, na wɔmaa no tumi sɛ ɔnyɛ deɛ ɔpɛ biara abosome aduanan mmienu.
13.6: Ɔhyɛɛ aseɛ domee Onyankopɔn, ne din, baabi a ɔte ne wɔn a wɔte ɔsoro nyinaa.
13.7: Wɔmaa no ɛkwan ma ɔne Onyankopɔn nkurɔfoɔ koeɛ sɛ ɔbɛdi wɔn so. Na wɔmaa no aman ne mmusuakuo ne nkurɔfoɔ ne kasa nyinaa mu so tumi.
13.8: Nnipa a wɔte asase so nyinaa bɛsom no: obiara a wantwerɛ ne din anhyɛ ateasefoɔ nwoma a ɛwɔ Odwammaa a wɔkumm no no mu ansa na wɔrebɔ ewiase.
13.10: “Obiara a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkyere no no, wɔbɛkyere no. Obiara a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkum no akofena ano no, wɔbɛkum no.” Yei mu boasetɔ ne gyidie ho hia Onyankopɔn nkurɔfoɔ.
13.11: Afei, mehunuu aboa foforɔ a ɔrepue afiri asase mu. Na ɔwɔ mmɛn mmienu te sɛ nnwammaa, nanso na ɔkasa te sɛ ɔtweaseɛ no.
13.12: Ɔsii aboa a ɔdi ɛkan no ananmu de ne tumi kɛseɛ no dii dwuma, na ɔhyɛɛ asase ne ɛso nnipa sɛ wɔnsom deɛ nʼapirakuro no awu no.
13.13: Aboa a ɔtɔ so mmienu yi yɛɛ anwanwadeɛ akɛseɛ bebree. Ɔmaa ogya firi ɔsoro baa asase so wɔ nnipa nyinaa anim.
13.14: Na ɔnam anwanwadeɛ a wɔmaa no ho ɛkwan yɛeɛ wɔ aboa a ɔdi ɛkan no anim no so daadaa nnipa a wɔte asase so nyinaa. Aboa no ka kyerɛɛ ewiase nnipa nyinaa sɛ, wɔnsi ohoni mfa nhyɛ aboa a wɔde akofena piraa no nanso nʼapirakuro no awu na ɔte ase no animuonyam.
13.15: Wɔmaa aboa a ɔtɔ so mmienu no ɛkwan ma ɔhomee nkwa guu aboa a ɔdi ɛkan ohoni no mu, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ohoni no bɛtumi akasa, na wakum obiara a ɔnsom no no.
13.16: Aboa no hyɛɛ nnipa nyinaa, nketewa ne akɛseɛ; adefoɔ ne ahiafoɔ, nkoa ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho sɛ wɔnhyɛ wɔn nsa nifa ho ne wɔn moma so agyiraeɛ.
13.17: Obiara nni ho ɛkwan sɛ ɔtɔ anaa ɔtɔn, gye sɛ wɔde aboa no din anaa nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a ɛgyina hɔ ma edin no hyɛ ne ho agyiraeɛ.
13.18: Yei hia ma nyansa. Obiara a ɔnim nyansa no bɛtumi ahunu nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a ɛgyina hɔ ma aboa no ase, ɛfiri sɛ, nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ no gyina hɔ ma onipa edin. Ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ yɛ ahansia aduosia nsia.

14.1: Afei, mehwɛeɛ na mehunuu sɛ Odwammaa no gyina Sion bepɔ so. Na nnipa ɔpeha aduanan ɛnan ka ne ho a wɔatwerɛ ne din ne nʼAgya din wɔ wɔn moma so.
14.2: Na metee nne bi firi ɔsoro a na ɛworo so te sɛ nsuworoeɛ a ano yɛ den, na ɛte sɛ aprannaa. Ɛnne a meteeɛ no te sɛ dwom a sankubɔfoɔ bi rebɔ wɔ ne sankuo so.
14.3: Wɔtoo dwom foforɔ bi wɔ ahennwa no ne ateasefoɔ baanan no ne mpanimfoɔ no anim. Nnipa ɔpeha aduanan ɛnan a wɔagye wɔn afiri asase so no nko ara na wɔtumi suaeɛ.
14.4: Wɔyɛ mmarima bi a wɔamfa mmaa angu wɔn ho fi, na wɔyɛ mmabunu. Baabiara a Odwammaa no bɛkɔ no na wɔdi nʼakyi. Wɔagye wɔn nkwa afiri nnipa mu na wɔne nnipa a wɔdi ɛkan a wɔde wɔn ama Onyankopɔn ne Odwammaa no.
14.5: Wɔnka atorɔsɛm, na mfomsoɔ nni wɔn ho.
14.6: Afei mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ sɛ watu nam ɔsorosoro a ɔrekɔka Asɛmpa a ɛntwam da no akyerɛ asase so nnipa a aman ne mmusuakuo ne kasa ne nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa ka ho.
14.7: Ɔteaam sɛ, “Monsuro Onyankopɔn na monkamfo ne kɛseyɛ. Ɛfiri sɛ, ɛberɛ no aduru sɛ ɔbu adasamma atɛn. Monsom deɛ ɔbɔɔ ɔsoro, asase, ɛpo ne nsutire no!”
14.8: Ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmienu dii deɛ ɔdi ɛkan no akyi kaa sɛ. “Wahwe ase! Babilonia kɛseɛ ahwe ase! Ɛfiri sɛ, wama amanaman nyinaa anom nʼadwamammɔ nsã no bi.”
14.9: Ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa a ɔdi baanu a wɔdi ɛkan no akyi teaam kaa sɛ, “Obiara a ɔsom aboa no ne ne sɛso ohoni a na ɔma wɔhyɛ ne nsa ho anaa ne moma so agyiraeɛ
14.10: no ankasa bɛnom Onyankopɔn nsã, nʼabufuo nsã a ɔde nʼahoɔden nyinaa ahwie agu nʼabufuo kuruwa mu no. Wɔn a wɔbɛyɛ saa no nyinaa, wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn ahoyera wɔ ogya ne sɔfe mu wɔ abɔfoɔ ne Odwammaa no anim.
14.11: Na ogya no wisie a ɛhyɛ wɔn ahoyera no kɔ ɔsoro daa daa. Awia ne anadwo, ahomegyeɛ nni hɔ ma wɔn a wɔsom aboa no ne ne sɛso ohoni ne obiara a wɔde ne din ahyɛ no agyiraeɛ no.”
14.12: Yei enti na ɛsɛ sɛ Onyankopɔn nkurɔfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔdi Onyankopɔn mmara so, na wɔgye Yesu di no nya boasetɔ no.
14.13: Afei, metee nne bi firi ɔsoro a ɛkaa sɛ, “Twerɛ yei. Nhyira ne awufoɔ a wɔwu Awurade mu firi seesei rekɔ yi.” Honhom no se, “Aane, wɔbɛhome afiri wɔn brɛ no mu; na wɔn nnwuma di wɔn akyi.”
14.14: Mehunuu omununkum fitaa bi na obi a ɔte sɛ Onipa Ba a sikakɔkɔɔ ahenkyɛ hyɛ no na ɔkura kantankrankyi nnamnnam bi wɔ ne nsam.
14.15: Afei, ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ bi firii asɔredan no mu pueeɛ, teaam kyerɛɛ deɛ ɔte omununkum no so no sɛ, “Fa wo kantankrankyi no twa ɛfiri sɛ otwaberɛ no aduru, asase no aso aba a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtwa!”
14.16: Enti, deɛ ɔte omununkum so no hwim ne kantankrankyi asase so maa ɛtwaa asase so nnɔbaeɛ.
14.17: Afei, mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ bi a ɔfiri ɔsoro asɔredan mu apue a ɔno nso kura kantankrankyi nnamnnam bi.
14.18: Ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ bi a ɔno nso hwɛ ogya no firi afɔrebukyia no mu pueeɛ. Ɔteaa ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔkura kantankrankyi nnamnnam no sɛ, “Fa wo kantankrankyi nnamnnam no twa asase so bobe no esia esia ɛfiri sɛ, nʼaba no abere.”
14.19: Enti, ɔbɔfoɔ no hwim ne kantankrankyi no wɔ asase so de twitwaa bobe aba no na ɔde kɔguu Onyankopɔn abufuo nsakyiamena kɛseɛ no mu.
14.20: Wɔtiatiaa bobe no so wɔ nsakyiamena a ɛwɔ kuropɔn no mfikyire, na mogya firii bobe no mu teneeɛ sɛ asubɔnten akwansini ahaanu a emu dɔ nso bɛyɛ anammɔn enum.

15.1: Mehunuu ade foforɔ bi a ɛso na ɛyɛ nwanwa wɔ ɔsoro. Na wɔyɛ abɔfoɔ baason a wɔkura ɔhaw nson a ɛno ne ɔhaw a ɛtwa toɔ, ɛfiri sɛ, ɛno na ɛkyerɛ Onyankopɔn abufuo a ɛtwa toɔ.
15.2: Afei, mehunuu biribi te sɛ ahwehwɛ ɛpo a wɔde ogya afra. Afei, mehunuu wɔn a wɔadi aboa no ne ne sɛso ohoni ne deɛ wɔde agyiraeɛ asi ne din anan mu no so nkonim. Na wɔgyinagyina ahwehwɛ ɛpo no ho a wɔkurakura asankuo a Onyankopɔn de ama wɔn no.
15.3: Na wɔreto Onyankopɔn akoa Mose dwom ne Odwammaa no dwom sɛ, “Awurade, Otumfoɔ Onyankopɔn, wo nnwuma yɛ akɛseɛ na ɛyɛ nwanwa Amansanhene Wʼakwan tene na ɛyɛ nokorɛ.
15.4: Hwan na ɔnsuro wo, Awurade? Hwan na ɔrenka wo kɛseyɛ? Wo nko na woyɛ kronkron. Aman nyinaa bɛba abɛsom wɔ wʼanim, ɛfiri sɛ, obiara ahunu wo tenenee nnwuma no.”
15.5: Afei mehunuu sɛ asɔredan a ɛwɔ ɔsoro hɔ no Kronkron mu Kronkron no abue a adanseɛ ntomadan si mu.
15.6: Abɔfoɔ baason a wɔmaa wɔn tumi sɛ wɔmfa ɔhaw nson mmra no pue firii asɔredan no mu, a wɔhyehyɛ ntadeɛ fitafitaa a wɔbobɔ sikakɔkɔɔ abɔsoɔ wɔ wɔn koko so.
15.7: Afei, ateasefoɔ baanan no mu baako maa abɔfoɔ baason no sikakɔkɔɔ nkuruwa nson a Onyankopɔn a ɔte ase daa daa no abufuo ahyɛ no ma.
15.8: Wisie a ɛfiri Onyankopɔn animuonyam ne ne tumi mu no hyɛɛ asɔredan no ma. Na obiara antumi ankɔ asɔredan no mu kɔsii sɛ ɔhaw nson a abɔfoɔ baason no de baeɛ no to twaeɛ.

16.1: Afei, metee nne bi sɛ ɛrekasa firi asɔredan mu hɔ kyerɛ abɔfoɔ no sɛ, “Mo nkɔ nkɔhwie Onyankopɔn abufuo nson a ɛwɔ nkuruwa nson mu no ngu asase so.”
16.2: Ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔdi ɛkan no kɔhwiee ne kuruwa no mu abufuo guu asase so. Akuro a ɛyɛ hu na ɛyɛ yea tutuu wɔn a wɔde aboa no ahyɛ wɔn ho agyiraeɛ no ne wɔn a wɔsom ne sɛso ohoni no nso.
16.3: Ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmienu no hwiee ne kuruwa no mu abufuo guu ɛpo mu. Nsuo no danee sɛ owufoɔ mogya, na abɔdeɛ biara a nkwa wɔ mu wɔ ɛpo no mu no wuiɛ.
16.4: Ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa no hwiee ne kuruwa no mu abufuo guu nsubɔntene ne nsuwa mu maa ne nyinaa danee mogya.
16.5: Metee sɛ ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔhwɛ nsuo so no reka sɛ, “wʼatɛn a wobuo no yɛ atɛntenenee. Ɔkronkronni a wowɔ hɔ na wowɔ ha dada,
16.6: ɛfiri sɛ wahwie mo ahotefoɔ ne adiyifoɔ mogya agu, woama wɔn mogya sɛ wɔnnom, sɛdeɛ ɛfata wɔn.”
16.7: Afei, metee nne bi wɔ afɔrebukyia no so sɛ, “Aane, Awurade, Otumfoɔ Onyankopɔn, atɛn a wobu nyinaa yɛ atɛntenenee!”
16.8: Ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so ɛnan no hwiee ne kuruwa no mu abufuo guu owia so na wɔmaa no tumi sɛ ɔnhye nnipa.
16.9: Owia hyeɛ no anoden maa nnipa domee Onyankopɔn a ɔwɔ saa ɔhaw yi nyinaa so tumi no din. Nanso, wɔannu wɔn ho anhyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam.
16.10: Afei, ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so enum no hwiee ne kuruwa no mu abufuo guu aboa no ahennwa no so. Esum duruu aboa no ahemman mu, na ɛsiane yea enti, nnipa wee wɔn tɛkrɛma;
16.11: na ɛsiane saa yea no ne akuro a ɛtutuu wɔn no enti, wɔdomee ɔsoro Onyankopɔn. Nanso, wɔantwe wɔn ho amfiri wɔn bɔne ho.
16.12: Ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nsia no hwiee ne kuruwa no mu abufuo guu Asubɔnten Eufrate mu. Asuo no weweeɛ, danee ɛkwan maa ahene a wɔfiri apueeɛ.
16.13: Afei, mehunuu ahonhommɔne mmiɛnsa bi a na wɔte sɛ mponkyerɛne a na wɔfifiri ɔtweaseɛ no ne aboa no ne atorɔ odiyifoɔ no anom.
16.14: Wɔyɛ ahonhommɔne a wɔyɛ anwanwadeɛ. Saa ahonhom mmiɛnsa yi kɔ ahene a wɔwɔ asase so nyinaa nkyɛn kɔka wɔn nyinaa boa ano ma Otumfoɔ Onyankopɔn ɔko da kɛseɛ no.
16.15: “Montie! Mereba te sɛ ɔkorɔmfoɔ. Nhyira ne deɛ ɔwɛn na ɔhwɛ ne ntadeɛ so, sɛdeɛ ɔrennante adagya ngu ne ho anim ase wɔ badwam!”
16.16: Ahonhom no boaa ahene no ano wɔ baabi a Hebri kasa mu wɔfrɛ hɔ Armagedon.
16.17: Afei, ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nson no hwiee ne kuruwa no mu abufuo guu mframa mu. Nne denden bi firi ahennwa a ɛwɔ asɔredan no mu no kaa sɛ, “Wɔawie.”
16.18: Na anyinam tete maa aprannaa paapaeɛ, ɛnna asasewosoɔ denden bi baeɛ. Ɛfirii sɛ wɔbɔɔ onipa no, asasewosoɔ biara mmaa saa da. Yei ne asasewosoɔ nyinaa mu deɛ ano yɛ den pa ara.
16.19: Kuro kɛseɛ no mu paee mmiɛnsa, na aman nyinaa nkuro akɛseɛ sɛesɛeɛ. Onyankopɔn kaee Babilonia kɛseɛ no, na ɔmaa no nsã a ano yɛ den a ɛyɛ nʼabufuo firi ne kuruwa ano nomeɛ.
16.21: Asukɔtweaa kɛseɛ a ebiara mu duru yɛ kilogram aduonum tɔ firii soro guu nnipa so. Na ɛsiane asukɔtweaa no haw a na ɛyɛ hu no enti, nnipa domee Onyankopɔn.

17.1: Abɔfoɔ baason no mu baako a ɔkura nkuruwa nson no baa me nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ, “Bra na menkyerɛ wo kwan a wɔbɛfa so atwe odwamanfoɔ kɛseɛ a ɔte nsuo pii so no aso.
17.2: Ewiase ahene ne no bɔɔ adwaman, na asase so nnipa aboto wɔ nʼadwaman nsã no mu.”
17.3: Honhom no faa me maa ɔbɔfoɔ no de me kɔɔ ɛserɛ so. Ɛhɔ na mehunuu ɔbaa bi sɛ ɔte aboa kɔkɔɔ bi a wɔatwerɛ edin a ɛyɛ abususɛm agu ne ho nyinaa. Na aboa no wɔ tire nson, ne mmɛn edu.
17.4: Na ɔbaa no hyɛ atadeɛ afasebire ne kɔkɔɔ a ɔde sikakɔkɔɔ aboɔ ne nhweneɛ a ne boɔ yɛ den ahyehyɛ ne ho. Na ɔkura sika kuruwa a afideɛ ne adwamammɔ ho nneɛma ayɛ no ma tɔ.
17.5: Na wɔatwerɛ edin bi wɔ ne moma so a ne nkyerɛaseɛ no wɔ ahintasɛm mu sɛ, “Babilonia kɛseɛ asase so adwamanfoɔ ne akyiwadeɛ maame.”
17.6: Na mehunuu sɛ Onyankopɔn nkurɔfoɔ ne Yesu akyidifoɔ a wɔkumm wɔn no mogya aboro no. Mehunuu no no, ɛyɛɛ me nwanwa.
17.7: Ɔbɔfoɔ no bisaa me sɛ, “Adɛn enti na ɛyɛ wo nwanwa? Mɛkyerɛ wo ahintasɛm nkyerɛaseɛ a ɛwɔ ɔbaa no ne aboa no a ɔwɔ tire nson ne mmɛn edu a ɔte ne so no ho.
17.8: Aboa a wohunuu no no na ɔte ase, nanso ɔnte ase bio. Ɔrebɛfiri bunu no mu aba ama wɔasɛe no. Nnipa a wɔte asase so a wɔantwerɛ wɔn din angu ateasefoɔ nwoma no mu ansa na wɔrebɔ ewiase no, sɛ wɔhunu aboa no a, ɛbɛyɛ wɔn nwanwa. Ɛberɛ bi na ɔte ase, nanso seesei ɔnte ase na ɔbɛsane aba.
17.9: “Nyansa ne nteaseɛ ho hia wɔ ha. Etire nson no gyina hɔ ma mmepɔ nson, mmepɔ a ɔbaa no tena so. Wɔyɛ ahene baason nso
17.10: a wɔn mu baanum awuwu, na wɔn mu baako da so di ɔhene na ɔbaako a ɔka wɔn ho no mmaeɛ. Na sɛ ɔba a ɔbɛdi ɔhene kakra.
17.11: Aboa no a anka na ɔte ase na afei deɛ, ɔnte ase no yɛ ɔhene a ɔtɔ so nwɔtwe a ɔka baason a wɔdi ɛkan no ho a ɔrekɔ ne sɛeɛ mu.
17.12: “Mmɛn edu a wohunuiɛ no yɛ ahene edu a wɔmfirii wɔn ahennie ase a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi na wɔne aboa no adi ɔhene dɔnhwereɛ no.
17.13: Wɔn nyinaa wɔ botaeɛ baako, na wɔde wɔn ahoɔden ne wɔn tumi bɛma aboa no.
17.14: Wɔbɛko atia Odwammaa no, na ɔno ne nʼakyidifoɔ, agyidifoɔ ne nokwafoɔ a wɔafrɛ wɔn no bɛdi wɔn so, ɛfiri sɛ, ɔyɛ awuranom mu Awurade ne ahene mu Ɔhene.”
17.15: Ɔbɔfoɔ no nso ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, “Nsuo a wohunuiɛ a odwamanfoɔ no te so no yɛ nkuro ne nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo ne aman ne kasa hodoɔ.
17.16: Mmɛn edu ne aboa no a wohunuiɛ no bɛkyiri odwamanfoɔ no. Wɔbɛfa biribiara a ɛwɔ ne ho ama wada adagya. Wɔbɛwe ne nam na wɔde ogya ahye no.
17.17: Ɛfiri sɛ, Onyankopɔn de ahyɛ wɔn akoma mu sɛ wɔbɛpene so de wɔn tumi ama aboa no na wadi ɔhene kɔsi sɛ Onyankopɔn asɛm no bɛba mu de ahyɛ ne botaeɛ no ma.
17.18: Ɔbaa a wohunuu no no yɛ kuro kɛseɛ a ɛdi asase so ahene so.”

18.1: Yei akyi, mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ sɛ ɔfiri ɔsoro reba fam. Na ɔwɔ tumi kɛseɛ na nʼanimuonyam hyerɛn asase so nyinaa.
18.2: Ɔteaam dendeenden sɛ, “ ‘Wahwe ase! Babilonia kɛseɛ ahwe ase!’ Adane ahonhommɔne tenaberɛ ne ahonhom efi nyinaa atɛeɛ. Nnomaa a wɔyɛ efi a wɔkyiri wɔn nyinaa te ne mu.
18.3: Ɔde ne nsã a ɛyɛ nʼadwamammɔ a ano yɛ den no maa nnipa nyinaa nomeeɛ. Asase so ahene ne no bɔɔ adwaman, na asase so adwadifoɔ nam nʼahonya mmorosoɔ so nyaa wɔn ho.”
18.4: Afei, metee nne foforɔ bi a ɛfiri ɔsoro ka sɛ, “Momfiri, me nkurɔfoɔ, na moamfa mo ho amfra bɔne a ɔyɛ no mu, na mo ne no ankyɛre nʼasotweɛ!
18.5: Ɛfiri sɛ, wɔahyehyɛ ne bɔne atoatoa abɛduru soro, na Onyankopɔn akae nʼawudie no.
18.6: Sɛdeɛ ɔyɛɛ mo no, monyɛ no saa pɛpɛɛpɛ; deɛ ɔyɛɛ mo biara no, montua ne so ka mprenu. Nsa a ɔde maa mo no, monhyɛ no deɛ ano yɛ den mmɔho mmienu.
18.7: Momma nʼayayadeɛ ne nʼawerɛhoɔ nnɔɔso sɛ animuonyam ne ahonya a ɔpɛ maa ne ho no. Ɛfiri sɛ, daa ɔka sɛ, ‘Mete ha sɛ ɔhemmaa; menyɛ okunafoɔ, na me werɛ renho da!’
18.8: Yei enti, nʼamanehunu a ɛyɛ yadeɛ awerɛhoɔ ne ɛkɔm bɛba ne so da bi. Na wɔde ogya ahye no, ɛfiri sɛ, Awurade Onyankopɔn a ɔbu no atɛn no yɛ kɛseɛ.
18.9: “Sɛ asase so ahene a wɔne no bɔɔ adwaman, dii dɛ no hunu hye a wɔrehye no no wisie a, wɔbɛsu atwa agyaadwoɔ.
18.10: Nʼamanehunu no hu a ɛyɛ enti, wɔbɛgyina akyiri asu sɛ, “ ‘Due! Due, Ao, kuropɔn kɛseɛ, Ao Babilonia, kuropɔn a ɛwɔ tumi! Dɔnhwere baako pɛ mu, wʼatemmuo aba.’
18.11: “Adwadifoɔ a wɔwɔ asase so nso su no ɛfiri sɛ, obiara ntɔ wɔn nneɛma bio.
18.12: Obiara ntɔ sikakɔkɔɔ ne dwetɛ, ne aboɔden aboɔ ne nhweneɛ pa, ne nwera pa ne ntoma afasebire ne serekye ne tam kɔkɔɔ, ne nnua a ɛyɛ hwam nyinaa ne asonse adwinneɛ nyinaa, ne adwinneɛ a wɔde nnua a ɛwɔ din ayɛ, ne ayowaa ne dadeɛ ne abohemaa,
18.13: ne pɛperɛ ne mmorɔngo, ne nnuhwam ne kurobo, ne hwamfufuo ne nsã ne ngo, ne asikyiresiam muhumuhu ne ayuo, ne nyɛmmoa ne nnwan ne apɔnkɔ ne nteaseɛnam ne nkoa ne nnipa akra.
18.14: “Adwadifoɔ no bɛka sɛ, ‘Nneɛma pa a wopere hwehwɛeɛ no nyinaa ayera, na wʼahonya ne wʼanimuonyam no kɔ, na wo nsa renka bio.’
18.15: Adwadifoɔ a wɔnyaa wɔn ho wɔ kuro no mu no bɛgyina akyirikyiri ɛfiri sɛ, wɔsuro amanehunu a ɔrehunu no. Wɔbɛsu na wɔatwa agyaadwoɔ,
18.16: na wɔaka sɛ: “ ‘Due! Due, Ao, kuropɔn kɛseɛ a ɔfira nwera pa ne ntoma afasebire ne tam kɔkɔɔ, na sika ne aboɔden aboɔ ne nhwene pa bobɔ mu.
18.17: Dɔnhwere pɛ, na saa ahonya dodoɔ yi asɛe.’ “Ahyɛnkafoɔ panin ne ɛhyɛn no mu nnipa, ne ɛhyɛn no mu adwumayɛfoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔka ho a wɔnya wɔn anoduane firi ɛhyɛn adwumayɛ mu no nyinaa gyinaa akyirikyiri.
18.18: Wɔsuiɛ wɔ ɛberɛ a wɔhunuu ogya a ɛrehyeɛ no wisie no, wɔteam ka sɛ ‘Kuropɔn biara a ne kɛseɛ te sɛi mmaa da.’ ”
18.19: Wɔtoo mfuturo guu wɔn atifi na wɔsu twaa agyaadwoɔ sɛ, “ ‘Due! Due Ao kuropɔn kɛseɛ, wo a wɔn a wɔwɔ ahyɛn wɔ wo mu no nam wʼahonya so yɛɛ adefoɔ. Na dɔnhwereɛ baako pɛ mu, wɔahwere biribiara!’
18.20: “Ma wʼani nnye ne ho. Ao, ɔsoro! Ahotefoɔ ne asomafoɔ ne adiyifoɔ mo ani nnye! Ɛkwan a ɔde mo faa so enti, Onyankopɔn abu no atɛn.”
18.21: Afei, ɔbɔfoɔ hoɔdenfoɔ bi faa ɛboɔ a ne kɛseɛ bɛyɛ sɛ owiyammoɔ to twenee ɛpo mu kaa sɛ, “Saa ahoɔden yi ara na wɔde bɛto Babilonia kɛseɛ no atwene, a wɔrenhunu no bio.
18.22: Wɔrente sankubɔfoɔ ne nnwomtofoɔ, atɛntɛbɛnbɔfoɔ ne totorobɛntohyɛnfoɔ nka bio wɔ mo mu. Wɔrenhunu odwumfoɔ biara wɔ wo mu bio. Na wɔrente owiyamfoɔ biara nka wɔ wo mu bio.
18.23: Kanea hann renhyerɛn wɔ wo mu bio. Wɔrente ayeforɔkunu ne ayeforɔyere nne wɔ wo mu bio. Wʼadwadifoɔ yɛ ewiase mu nnipa titire. Na wɔde wo ntafowayie adaadaa aman nyinaa.
18.24: Wɔ ne mu na wɔhunuu adiyifoɔ ne ahotefoɔ ne wɔn a wɔkumm wɔn asase so nyinaa mogya.”

19.1: Yei akyi no, metee nne bi te sɛ nnipakuo a wɔwɔ ɔsoro reteam sɛ, “Haleluia! Nkwagyeɛ ne animuonyam ne tumi wɔ yɛn Onyankopɔn,
19.2: ɛfiri sɛ, nʼatemmuo yɛ nokorɛ na ɛyɛ sɛ ɔbuu odwamanfoɔ kɛseɛ a ɔde nʼadwamammɔ asɛe asase no atɛn. Onyankopɔn atwe nʼaso ɛfiri sɛ, ɔkumm nʼasomfoɔ.”
19.3: Na afei, wɔteaam bio sɛ, “Haleluia! Wisie bɛfiri kuro no mu akɔ ɔsoro daa daa.”
19.4: Mpanimfoɔ aduonu ɛnan ne ateasefoɔ baanan no butubutuu Onyankopɔn a ɔte nʼahennwa so no anim somm no. Na wɔteaam sɛ, “Amen, Haleluia!”
19.5: Afei, nne bi firi ahennwa no so baa sɛ, “Monkamfo yɛn Onyankopɔn, mo a moyɛ nʼasomfoɔ nyinaa, mo a mosuro no, akɛseɛ ne nkumaa!”
19.6: Afei, metee nne bi te sɛ nnipadɔm a ɛte sɛ nsuworosoɔ ne aprannaa a ɛrepaapae a ɛreteam sɛ, “Haleluia! Yɛn Otumfoɔ Awurade Onyankopɔn di ɔhene.
19.7: Momma yɛn ho nsɛpɛ yɛn na yɛn ani nnye na yɛnhyɛ no animuonyam! Ɛfiri sɛ Odwammaa no ayeforɔhyia aduru, na nʼayefokunu asiesie ne ho.
19.8: Wɔde nwera pa a ani hyerɛn na ani teɛ maa no sɛ ɔnhyɛ.” (Nwera no kyerɛ ahotefoɔ tenenee nneyɛɛ.)
19.9: Afei, ɔbɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, “Twerɛ sɛ, Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔato nsa afrɛ wɔn Odwammaa no ayeforɔhyia anwummerɛ apontoɔ ase.” Ɔka kaa ho sɛ, “Yei yɛ Onyankopɔn asɛm turodoo.”
19.10: Mebutuu ne nan ase pɛɛ sɛ mesom no. Nanso, ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, “Nyɛ saa, ɛfiri sɛ, meyɛ ɔsomfoɔ te sɛ wo ne wo nuanom a wɔdi Yesu ho adanseɛ no. Som Onyankopɔn ɛfiri sɛ, nokorɛ a Yesu daa no adi no na ɛhyɛ adiyifoɔ no nkuran.”
19.11: Afei, mehunuu sɛ ɔsoro abue a ɔpɔnkɔ fitaa wɔ hɔ. Na deɛ ɔte ne so no edin de “Ɔseadeɛyɛ ne Ɔnokwafoɔ.” Nokorɛ na ɔgyina so bu atɛn na ɔko ne ko.
19.12: Nʼaniwa te sɛ ogya a ɛrederɛ na ɔhyɛ ahenkyɛ bebree. Na ɔwɔ din bi a wɔatwerɛ agu ne ho, nanso na obiara nnim edin no nkyerɛaseɛ ka ne ho.
19.13: Na ɔhyɛ atadeɛ bi a wɔde anu mogya mu. Na ne din ne “Onyankopɔn Asɛm”
19.14: Ɔsoro asraafoɔ a wɔhyehyɛ nwera fitaa a ani te a wɔtete apɔnkɔ fitafitaa so dii nʼakyi.
19.15: Akofena a ano yɛ nnam yie a ɔde bɛdi aman so firii nʼanom baeɛ. Dadeɛ poma na ɔde bɛdi wɔn so. Sɛdeɛ wɔtiatia bobe a ɛwɔ nsakyiamena mu no so no, saa ara na ɔbɛtiatia nnipa no so de akyerɛ Onyankopɔn Otumfoɔ no abufuo.
19.16: Na wɔatwerɛ edin agu nʼatadeɛ mu ne ne srɛ ho sɛ: ahene mu ɔhene ne awuranom mu awurade.
19.17: Afei, mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ bi a ɔgyina owia mu. Ɔteaam guu nnomaa a wɔnam ewiem nyinaa so sɛ, “Mommra mmɛhyiam wɔ Onyankopɔn apontoɔ kɛseɛ no ase.
19.18: Mommɛdi ahemfo nam ne asafohene nam ne atumfoɔ nam ne apɔnkɔ ne wɔn sotefoɔ nam ne adehyeɛ ne nkoa ne akɛseɛ ne nkumaa nyinaa nam.”
19.19: Afei, mehunuu aboa no ne asase so ahene ne wɔn asraafoɔ a wɔaboa wɔn ho ano rekɔko atia deɛ ɔte ɔpɔnkɔ no so no ne ne dɔm.
19.20: Wɔkyeree aboa no ne nʼatorɔdiyifoɔ a ɔyɛɛ anwanwadeɛ maa no no. Saa anwanwadeɛ no so na ɔnam daadaa wɔn a wɔde aboa no ahyɛ wɔn agyiraeɛ ne wɔn a wɔsom aboa no ohoni no. Wɔtoo aboa no ne atorɔdiyifoɔ no anikann guu ogya ɔtadeɛ a sɔfe na na ɛrederɛ wɔ mu no mu.
19.21: Wɔde akofena a ɛfiri ɔpɔnkɔkafoɔ no anom kunkumm wɔn asraafoɔ, na nnomaa no dii wɔn nam sɛdeɛ wɔbɛtumi.

20.1: Afei, mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ bi sɛ ɔfiri ɔsoro reba fam a na ɔkura ebunu no safoa ne nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn duruduru bi.
20.2: Ɔkyeree ɔtweaseɛ kɛseɛ dada a ɔyɛ ɔbonsam no kyekyeree no mfeɛ apem.
20.3: Ɔbɔfoɔ no too no twenee ebunu no mu, too mu safoa sɔɔ ano sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, mfeɛ apem no bɛtwam. Ɛno akyi wɔbɛgyaa no kakra.
20.4: Afei, mehunuu nhennwa ne wɔn a wɔtete so a wɔama wɔn tumi sɛ wɔmmu atɛn. Afei mehunuu wɔn a ɛsiane sɛ wɔada nokorɛ ne Onyankopɔn asɛm a Yesu kaeɛ no adi enti, wɔatwitwa wɔn ti no akra. Wɔansom aboa no ne ne honi no. Saa ara nso na wɔamfa aboa no agyiraeɛhyɛdeɛ anhyɛ wɔn moma so ne wɔn nsa ho agyiraeɛ. Wɔbaa nkwa mu ne Kristo bɛdii ahene mfeɛ apem. Awufoɔ a wɔaka no annyane kɔsii mfeɛ apem no akyi.
20.5: Yei ne awufosɔreɛ a ɛdi ɛkan.
20.6: Nhyira bebree nka wɔn a wɔdii ɛkan nyanee wɔn firii awufoɔ mu. Owuo a ɛtɔ so mmienu no nni wɔn so tumi. Wɔbɛyɛ Onyankopɔn ne Kristo asɔfoɔ. Na wɔne no bɛdi ahene mfeɛ apem.
20.7: Mfeɛ apem no akyi, wɔbɛyi ɔbonsam afiri afiase hɔ;
20.8: na ɔbɛkɔ akɔdaadaa aman a ɛwɔ ewiase nyinaa a ɛyɛ Gog ne Magog. Ɔbonsam bɛboaboa wɔn ano a wɔn dodoɔ bɛyɛ sɛ mpoano anwea de wɔn akɔ ɔko.
20.9: Wɔtuu sa kɔɔ asase so nyinaa kɔtwaa Onyankopɔn nkurɔfoɔ atenaeɛ, a ɛyɛ ɔman a ɔdɔ no no ho hyiaeɛ. Nanso, ogya firi soro bɛsɛee wɔn.
20.10: Ɛnna wɔtoo ɔbonsam a ɔdaadaa wɔn no nso too ogya tadeɛ ne sɔfe a wɔde aboa no ne atorɔ odiyifoɔ no ato mu no mu. Na wɔbɛyɛ wɔn ayayadeɛ awia ne anadwo daa daa.
20.11: Afei, mehunuu ahennwa fitaa kɛseɛ bi ne deɛ ɔte so no. Asase ne ɔsoro dwanee wɔ nʼanim, na wɔanhunu wɔn bio.
20.12: Na mehunuu awufoɔ akɛseɛ ne nketewa sɛ wɔgyinagyina ahennwa no anim. Wobuebuee nwoma bebree mu, ɛnna wobuee nwoma foforɔ bi a ɛyɛ ateasefoɔ nwoma no mu. Wɔbuu awufoɔ no atɛn, sɛdeɛ wɔn nnwuma te ne sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ wɔ nwoma ahodoɔ no mu no.
20.13: Afei, ɛpo nso danee nʼawufoɔ maeɛ. Owuo ne asaman nso de wɔn awufoɔ maeɛ. Na wɔbuu wɔn nyinaa atɛn sɛdeɛ wɔn nnwuma teɛ.
20.14: Na wɔtoo owuo ne asaman guu ogya tadeɛ no mu. Saa ogya tadeɛ yi ne owuprenu no.
20.15: Na obiara a wɔantwerɛ ne din angu nkwa nwoma no mu no, wɔtoo no twenee ogya tadeɛ no mu.

21.1: Afei, mehunuu ɔsoro foforɔ ne asase foforɔ, na kane ɔsoro ne kane asase no atwam, na ɛpo nso nni hɔ bio.
21.2: Na mehunuu Kuro Kronkron a ɛyɛ Yerusalem foforɔ sɛ ɛfiri Onyankopɔn hɔ wɔ ɔsoro reba fam, a wasiesie ne ho te sɛ ayeforɔ a ɔrekɔhyia ne kunu.
21.3: Metee nne denden bi firi ahennwa no so sɛ, “Afei, Onyankopɔn atenaeɛ wɔ nnipa mu. Ɔne wɔn bɛtena na wɔayɛ ne nkurɔfoɔ. Onyankopɔn no ankasa ne wɔn bɛtena na wayɛ wɔn Onyankopɔn.
21.4: Na ɔbɛpepa wɔn aniwa mu nisuo nyinaa. Na owuo nni hɔ bio, na awerɛhoɔ ne osu ne yea nni hɔ bio. Na kane nneɛma no atwam.”
21.5: Afei, deɛ ɔte ahennwa no so no kaa sɛ, “Afei, mereyɛ nneɛma nyinaa foforɔ!” Ɔka kyerɛɛ me nso sɛ, “Twerɛ yei, ɛfiri sɛ, saa nsɛm yi yɛ nokorɛ a wɔde wɔn ho to so.”
21.6: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, “Wɔawie! Me ne Alfa ne Omega, Ahyɛaseɛ ne Awieeɛ no. Obiara a sukɔm de no no, mɛma no nsuo a ɛfiri nkwa asutire mu anom kwa.
21.7: Obiara a ɔbɛdi nkonim no bɛnya yei afiri me nkyɛn. Mɛyɛ ne Onyankopɔn na ɔno nso ayɛ me ba.
21.8: Nanso, ahufoɔ ne wɔn a wɔnnye nni ne akyiwadeyɛfoɔ ne awudifoɔ ne adwamanfoɔ ne adutofoɔ ne abosonsomfoɔ ne atorofoɔ nyinaa bɛnya wɔn kyɛfa wɔ ɔtadeɛ a ogya ne sɔfe dɛre wɔ mu no. Ɛno ne owuprenu no.”
21.9: Abɔfoɔ baason a wɔkurakura nkuruwa nson a ɔhaw nson a ɛtwa toɔ no ahyɛ ma wɔ mu baako baa me nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ, “Bra, na mɛkyerɛ wo Ayeforɔ a ɔyɛ Odwammaa no yere no.”
21.10: Honhom no faa me, na ɔbɔfoɔ no de me kɔɔ bepɔ tenten bi atifi. Ɔkyerɛɛ me Yerusalem, Kuro Kronkron a ɛfiri ɔsoro, Onyankopɔn hɔ, resiane aba fam.
21.11: Ɛhyerɛn Onyankopɔn animuonyam mu, na ne hyerɛn no te sɛ aboɔdenboɔ a ɛsɛ ahwehwɛboɔ a ani te sɛ ahwehwɛ.
21.12: Na ne ɔfasuo no wɔ ahoɔden na ɛware yie nso. Apono dumienu gu ano a, abɔfoɔ dumienu na wɔhwɛ so. Na ɛpono biara so no wɔatwerɛ Israel mmusuakuo dumienu no mu baako din.
21.13: Apono mmiɛnsa wɔ apueeɛ; mmiɛnsa wɔ anafoɔ; mmiɛnsa wɔ atifi ɛnna mmiɛnsa wɔ atɔeɛ.
21.14: Wɔsii kuro no afasuo sii aboɔ dumienu a wɔatwerɛ Odwammaa no asomafoɔ dumienu no din wɔ so no so.
21.15: Ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔkasa kyerɛɛ me no kura sikakɔkɔɔ poma susudua a wɔde bɛsusu kuro no, nʼapono ne nʼafasuo.
21.16: Na kuro no yɛ ahinanan a ne tenten ne ne trɛ yɛ pɛ. Ɔbɔfoɔ no de ne susudua no susuu kuro no. Na ne tenten yɛ kilomita mpem mmienu ne ahanan (2,400), na ne tɛtrɛtɛ, ne ɔsorokɔ ne ne tenten nyinaa yɛ pɛ.
21.17: Ɔbɔfoɔ no susuu ɔfasuo no nso a na ne ɔsorokɔ nso bɛyɛ sɛ mita aduosia.
21.18: Ahwehwɛboɔ na ɔde too afasuo no. Na kuro no deɛ, sikakɔkɔɔ amapa a ɛhyerɛn te sɛ ahwehwɛ na wɔde toeɛ.
21.19: Wɔde aboɔdenboɔ ahodoɔ a ɛyɛ fɛ na ɛhyehyɛɛ kuro no fapem. Fapem a ɛdi ɛkan yɛ ahwehwɛboɔ. Fapem a ɛtɔ so mmienu yɛ aboɔdemmoɔ. Fapem a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa yɛ omununkumboɔ. Fapem a ɛtɔ so ɛnan yɛ ahahammonoboɔ.
21.20: Fapem a ɛtɔ so enum yɛ ɛtɔnboɔ. Fapem a ɛtɔ so nsia yɛ bogyanamboɔ. Fapem a ɛtɔ so nson yɛ sikabereɛboɔ. Fapem a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe yɛ apopobibirieboɔ. Fapem a ɛtɔ so nkron yɛ akraateboɔ. Fapem a ɛtɔ so edu yɛ dɛnkyɛmmoɔ. Fapem a ɛtɔ so dubaako yɛ wisiboɔ. Fapem a ɛtɔ so dumienu yɛ beredumboɔ.
21.21: Na wɔde nhwene pa dumienu na ɛyɛɛ apono dumienu no. Apono no mu biara, wɔde ahene pa baako na ɛyɛeɛ. Na kuro no abɔntene kɛseɛ yɛ sika amapa kronn a ɛte sɛ ahwehwɛ.
21.22: Na manhunu asɔredan wɔ kuro no mu baabiara ɛfiri sɛ, Awurade Onyankopɔn Otumfoɔ ne Odwammaa no ne asɔredan.
21.23: Na owia anaa ɔsrane hann nhia kuro no ɛfiri sɛ, na Onyankopɔn ne Odwammaa no animuonyam hyerɛn wɔ hɔ.
21.24: Ne hann no bɛhyerɛn asase so aman nyinaa so, na asase so aman so ahene de wɔn ahodeɛ bɛba hɔ.
21.25: Wɔntoto kuro no apono mu. Ɛda biara ano da hɔ. Ɛfiri sɛ, esum nnuru wɔ hɔ.
21.26: Wɔde aman no kɛseyɛ ne wɔn ahonya bɛba kuro no mu.
21.27: Nanso, biribiara a ɛho nte nkɔ kuro no mu. Saa ara na obi a ɔyɛ aniwudeɛ anaa ɔtwa atorɔ nkɔ mu. Wɔn a wɔatwerɛ wɔn din ahyɛ Odwammaa no nkwa nwoma no mu no nko ara na wɔbɛkɔ kuro no mu.

22.1: Ɔbɔfoɔ no kyerɛɛ me nkwa asubɔnten a ani te korɔgyenn sɛ ahwehwɛ a ɛfiri Onyankopɔn ne Odwammaa no ahennwa so,
22.2: a ɛtene fa kuro no abɔntene mfimfini. Asuo no fa biara, nkwa dua si hɔ a ɛso aba ahodoɔ dumienu ɔbosome biara. Wɔde ɛso ahahan no sa aman ahodoɔ no yadeɛ.
22.3: Biribiara a ɛwɔ Onyankopɔn nnome ase no nkɔ kuro no mu. Wɔbɛhunu Onyankopɔn ne Odwammaa no ahennwa wɔ kuro no mu na nʼasomfoɔ bɛsom no.
22.4: Wɔbɛhunu nʼanim na wɔbɛtwerɛ ne din agu wɔn moma so.
22.5: Adeɛ rensa wɔ hɔ bio, na nkanea anaa hann ho nhia ɛfiri sɛ, Awurade Onyankopɔn bɛyɛ wɔn hann na wɔbɛdi adeɛ sɛ ahene daa daa.
22.6: Afei, ɔbɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, “Saa nsɛm yi yɛ nokorɛ a wode wo ho to so a, ɛyɛ. Na Awurade Onyankopɔn a ɔde Honhom ma adiyifoɔ somaa ne ɔbɔfoɔ sɛ ɔmmɛkyerɛ nʼasomfoɔ deɛ ɛbɛba nnansa yi ara no.”
22.7: Yesu kaa sɛ, “Montie! Mereba nnansa yi ara, Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔtie adiyisɛm a ɛwɔ saa nwoma yi mu no!”
22.8: Me, Yohane, mate na mahunu saa nneɛma yi nyinaa. Na metee ne nyinaa, hunuu ne nyinaa wieeɛ no, mebutuu ɔbɔfoɔ no a ɔkyerɛɛ me saa nneɛma yi nyinaa nan ase pɛɛ sɛ mesom no.
22.9: Nanso, ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, “Nyɛ saa! Meyɛ ɔsomfoɔ te sɛ wo nuanom adiyifoɔ ne wɔn a wɔdi nwoma yi mu nsɛm no so no ara pɛ. Som Onyankopɔn!”
22.10: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, “Nkata saa adiyisɛm a ɛwɔ nwoma yi mu no so, ɛfiri sɛ, ɛberɛ no abɛn.
22.11: Obiara a ɔyɛ bɔne nkɔ so nyɛ bɔne, na deɛ ɔyɛ efi no nkɔ so nyɛ efi; deɛ ɔyɛ papa no nkɔ so nyɛ papa, na deɛ ɔyɛ kronkron no nkɔ so nyɛ kronkron.”
22.12: Hwɛ! Mereba ntɛm! Mekura mʼabasobɔdeɛ sɛ mede rebɛma obiara sɛdeɛ nʼadwumayɛ teɛ.
22.13: Mene Alfa ne Omega, Ɔkannifoɔ ne Okyidifoɔ, Ahyɛaseɛ ne Awieeɛ.
22.14: “Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔhoro wɔn ntadeɛ, na wɔn na wɔwɔ ho ɛkwan sɛ wɔdi nkwa dua no aba na wɔfa kuro no ɛpono no mu.
22.15: Na Kuro no akyi na nkraman ne adutofoɔ ne adwamanfoɔ ne awudifoɔ ne abosonsomfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔpɛ atorɔ na wɔdi atorɔ no nyinaa wɔ.
22.16: “Me, Yesu, na masoma me ɔbɔfoɔ sɛ ɔmmɛbɔ mo saa nwoma yi nyinaa ho amaneɛ wɔ asafo mu. Meyɛ Dawid busuani. Mene anɔpa nsoromma a ɛhyerɛn no.”
22.17: Honhom no ne ayeforɔ no se, “Ɛsɛ sɛ obiara a ɔte saa asɛm yi nso ka sɛ, ‘Bra!’ Na deɛ osukɔm de no no mmra, na deɛ ɔpɛ no nso, ɔmmɛgye nkwa nsuo no kwa.”
22.18: Me, Yohane, mebɔ obiara a ɔte saa adiyisɛm a ɛwɔ nwoma yi mu kɔkɔ sɛ: Sɛ obi de bi ka ho a, Onyankopɔn de asotweɛ bɛka ne haw a wakyerɛ mu wɔ saa nwoma yi mu no ho.
22.19: Na sɛ obi nso yi bi firi adiyisɛm a ɛwɔ saa nwoma yi mu no mu a, Onyankopɔn bɛyi ne kyɛfa a ɔbɛnya wɔ nkwa dua no ne kuro Kronkron a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mu wɔ nwoma yi mu no.
22.20: Deɛ ɔdi nwoma yi ho adanseɛ no ka sɛ, “Aane! Mereba ntɛm!” Amen. Bra, Awurade Yesu!
22.21: Yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo adom nka ahotefoɔ nyinaa. Amen.
